import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_sub.columns.tolist()}")


# Text preprocessing function
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Convert to string
    text = str(text).strip()
    # Remove surrounding quotes if present
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    # Decode unicode escape sequences
    try:
        text = text.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
    except:
        pass
    # Clean up special characters but keep meaningful ones
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s!?.,\'\"-]", " ", text)
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


# Apply preprocessing
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Prepare features and target
X = train_df["Comment"].values
y = train_df["Insult"].values

# Create TF-IDF vectorizers for both character and word n-grams
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(3, 6),
    analyzer="char",
    max_features=30000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    analyzer="word",
    max_features=20000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit and transform training data
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X)

# Combine features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_char, X_train_word])

# Transform test data
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"].values)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"].values)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_char, X_test_word])

# Cross-validation for robust validation
n_splits = 5
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

oof_predictions = np.zeros(len(X))
test_predictions = np.zeros(len(test_df))

# Store validation scores
val_aucs = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(cv.split(X_train_combined, y)):
    X_train_fold = X_train_combined[train_idx]
    y_train_fold = y[train_idx]
    X_val_fold = X_train_combined[val_idx]
    y_val_fold = y[val_idx]

    # LightGBM classifier with optimized parameters
    lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=1000,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=63,
        max_depth=-1,
        min_child_samples=20,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    # Train model
    lgb_model.fit(
        X_train_fold,
        y_train_fold,
        eval_set=[(X_val_fold, y_val_fold)],
        eval_metric="auc",
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False)],
    )

    # Predict on validation set (genuine hold-out)
    y_val_pred = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val_fold)[:, 1]
    oof_predictions[val_idx] = y_val_pred

    # Predict on test set
    test_predictions += lgb_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1] / n_splits

    # Calculate AUC-ROC on validation fold
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_fold, y_val_pred)
    val_aucs.append(fold_auc)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC-ROC: {fold_auc:.4f}")

# Calculate overall validation AUC-ROC on out-of-fold predictions
oof_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_predictions)
print(f"\nOverall Validation AUC-ROC (Cross-Validation): {oof_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Mean CV AUC: {np.mean(val_aucs):.4f} (+/- {np.std(val_aucs):.4f})")

# Ensure predictions are in valid range [0, 1]
test_predictions = np.clip(test_predictions, 0.0, 1.0)

# Create submission file with correct format matching sample_submission_null.csv
# Sample submission has columns: Comment, Date, Insult
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Date": test_df["Date"], "Insult": test_predictions}
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(test_predictions)}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()}")
print(
    f"Prediction statistics: min={test_predictions.min():.4f}, max={test_predictions.max():.4f}, mean={test_predictions.mean():.4f}"
)
